opus.problem: Eleazar's hand sticking to his sword is a small detail, while the word's best-known uses are left out: 'the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God' (Ephesians 6:17), beating swords into plowshares (Isaiah 2:4), the word of God sharper than any double-edged sword (Hebrews 4:12), and 'all who draw the sword will die by the sword' (Matthew 26:52). Known stories should come before small details, so swap this clue for one of those.
